2: Of David, when he ⌞pretended to be crazy⌟ in front of Abimelech so that he drove him out, and so he departed. I will bless Yahweh at all times; his praise shall be in my mouth continually.
3: My soul makes its boast in Yahweh; let the humble hear and be glad.
4: Magnify Yahweh with me, and let us exalt his name together.
5: I sought Yahweh and he answered me, and from all my terrors he delivered me.
6: They looked to him and were radiant, and their faces shall not be ashamed.
7: This poor man called and Yahweh heard, and saved him from all his troubles.
8: The angel of Yahweh encamps around those who fear him, and he rescues them.
9: Taste and see that Yahweh is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
10: Fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack for those who fear him.
11: The young lions are in want and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh will not lack for any good thing.
12: Come, you children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
13: Who is the man who desires life, who loves many days in order to see good?
14: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
15: Turn from evil and do good. Seek peace and pursue it.
16: The eyes of Yahweh are toward the righteous, and his ears toward their cry for help.
17: The face of Yahweh is against evildoers, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
18: They cry out and Yahweh hears and delivers them from all of their troubles.
19: Yahweh is near to those who are heartbroken and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
20: Many are the distresses of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
21: He protects all his bones; not one of them is broken.
22: Evil will slay the wicked, and those who hate the righteous will incur guilt.
23: Yahweh redeems the life of his servants, and none who take refuge in him will incur guilt.
